TC-15/S24.title: A dictated question can be asked only once its last words have arrived (both settings)
TC-15/S24.detail: New local spec (review of TFA-92593): a copy of Tim's e2e/dictation-completion.spec.ts with the Ask button matched by /^Ask AI/ (its label is no longer exactly "Ask AI"). Speech recogniser mocked, the last words delivered 1.5 s after Stop; Ask AI never pressed (askChart answered with a failure if it were). Both settings: after Stop, Ask AI and Dictate are disabled and "Transcribing" shows; the last words land after the typed text ("Please check: What medications changed today?"); then both buttons are enabled again. 10/10 judged checks pass; no model call (tripwire clean).
